success_criteria.criterion: No must-level success criterion is subjective-only or lacks a container-verifiable capability; the acceptance-contract checker rejects both cases and blocks implementation if external criteria remain subjective-only.
`EffectRecordState.INDETERMINATE`, lease timing/recurrence policy, and the repair/effect allowlist are fail-closed and fully tested. All mark_* methods reject transitions from terminal states.

Imported-decision C01-C03: launch is blocked until source, seed epoch, runtime, marker, supervisor, and every executable consumer attest to one exact content-addressed revision; changed seed material archives the predecessor and requires a fresh epoch.

Imported-decision C04-C20: schema, authority, occurrence identity, recovery, effects, projection truth, evidence, replay, deferral, and retirement are one machine-verifiable structural contract; missing or contradictory evidence is indeterminate and cannot authorize progress.

Fresh candidate-bound deterministic feasibility evidence is produced after gate. Post-gate receipts carry explicit epoch/seed binding distinguishing them from pre-gate estimates. Finalize.py validates epoch-bound receipt fields from compile_task_feasibility. The batch.py missing-config bug is fixed so both assert_admitted_task_feasibility consumers (batch.py and execute.py) compute the same admission verdict. seed_epoch flows from Step 5B attestation through state injection into the payload before compile_task_feasibility; v2 plans with missing seed_epoch raise ValueError.
Duplicate WBC attempt/outbox keys compare canonical content; divergent duplicates raise typed conflicts and persist quarantine evidence.

One stable global logical-effect reservation spans attempts; concurrent or retried attempts cannot apply the same provider effect twice after lost acknowledgement. GLEK inputs are snapshotted at first reservation, persisted atomically, and reused across retries even after mid-flight inventory regeneration.
Per-attempt terminality supports multiple distinct effects, while an unresolved global effect remains terminally indeterminate, action-off, and escalated until safe reconciliation.
Custody raw writes are unavailable to production callers, lease invariants enforce owner/process/epoch/TTL/fencing, and domain actions use a separate non-bearer action gate.
Run Authority and WBC validators reread authoritative current sources; synthetic, projection-only, outbox-only, stale, conflicted, or cross-attempt-inconsistent evidence denies authorization.
Every fake provider or transport call follows durable reserve/start/intent/global reservation; failed persistence produces zero calls.

Normal, compensation, execute, Git, SSH, GitHub issue publication, delivery, loop/git, bakeoff, CLI, skills/subagent-launcher, MegaLoop user-command (both _run_user_command and _run_monitored_command), and resident/Discord effects use the WBC protocol or are mechanically action-off.

Execute and Git mutation inventories (including bakeoff, CLI, and loop modules) are source-anchored and complete; each implementation shard changes no more than three inventoried sinks (action_off rows are inventoried but not counted toward the migrated-row limit). The execute inventory has a completeness gate mirroring the Git overflow gate.

The WBC discovery-root generator includes cloud/, chain/, custody/, loop/, resident/, bakeoff/, cli/, and skills/ directories; the regenerated final inventory is joined row by row to the regenerated fault matrix; every supported mutating/provider row has executable fault/replay coverage and every other row has proven non-authorizing status.
Deferred rows are durably action-off, excluded from supported counts, and cause conformance failure if they dispatch or lack owner, expiry, source hash, and bypass evidence.
Provider reconciliation adopts APPLIED evidence without redispatch, permits retry only through provider idempotency or authoritative NOT_APPLIED reservation transfer, and keeps UNKNOWN action-off.
Cross-host transfer/reclaim accepts one current epoch and rejects stale-owner renew, complete, cancel, publish, deliver, GitHub, Git, SSH, loop/git, bakeoff, CLI, and Discord operations.
Event-driven recovery reports denominated p95 below 300 seconds or typed escalation; a missed event is reconciled by the six-hour backstop without making it a primary mutator.
Only an independent verifier with a negative control and current authority/custody/WBC rereads can close recovery.

Candidate-bound C01-C20 conformance includes launch, schema, feasibility, authority, custody, global effects, inventory, deferral, fault, replay, migration, rollback, recovery, and forged/stale negative evidence from the exact installed runtime.
Production effects and mutating repair remain action-off unless separately authorized after M10.
New adapters and checkers remain narrow, auditable, and data-driven.
The M11 genuine-block candidate package includes its kill switch, rollback, runtime provenance, verifier schedule, and no mocked status as acceptance evidence.
